resumeText: Maya Kapoor is a Computer Vision Engineer at PixelForge AI with four years of experience. She trains deep learning models in PyTorch and TensorFlow for classification and segmentation, working on image processing fundamentals and shipping services with Docker. Her vision background leans on deep learning and preprocessing rather than OpenCV-based pipelines, which she is actively building out.
